title: lichen-rpl: raw-path extract_updates nonzero-Target-flags reject lacks its own pin
description: Found by kimi-k3 correctness+edge review of cyjm (b7z9.3.1 reconciliation). After the structural-stage envelope guard landed (b926255ab2) and the b7z9.3.1 unit test moved its pin to verify_signature, the defense-in-depth flags check in rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs extract_updates (OPT_RPL_TARGET branch, opt.data[0] != 0 -> None) is no longer exercised by any test on the raw/unverified DAO API (process_dao / process_dao_at test-helpers); node-side mirror dao_parents_for_source IS pinned in the reconciliation test, and the R-05-035 requirement stays pinned at vector level (reject_target_flags_nonzero, structural). Gap: a regression removing the extract_updates check would go unnoticed. Fix: small in-module test in rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs tests mod (extract_updates is private) building a raw DAO with Target flags=0x01 and asserting extract_updates returns None (and one flags=0 control returning Some). Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-cyjm.
close_reason: VERIFIED FIXED in tree — no code change needed. The requested pin exists and passes: extract_updates_rejects_nonzero_target_flags at rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:1886-1924 builds a raw DAO with Target flags=0x01 (asserts extract_updates -> None) and flags=0x00 (asserts extraction succeeds with update_count=1). It exercises exactly the defense-in-depth check at routing.rs:1492 (OPT_RPL_TARGET: opt.data.len() < 2 || opt.data[0] != 0 -> return None, per R-05-035 / spec/05-routing.md §8.6, comment :1483-1492). Test passes (1/1). Regression coverage is live: removing the :1492 flags check makes the 0x01 case extract successfully and fails the pin.
